behavior: Attached record environment governs field reads/writes and context/privilege buckets; native compute_sudo callbacks receive elevated recordsets; caller channels are restored.
execution_flow: FieldDescriptor entry binding -> existing attached Environment call/scope -> unchanged descriptor bodies -> existing compute/cache machinery. compute_value derives native recordsets through sudo while preserving Django-row ambient path.
inputs_outputs: Same-id red/blue contexts stay distinct; ambient helpers see attached value only during operation; assignments enter attached bucket; exceptions restore context; two controlled threads restore their own channels; ordinary/elevated buckets separate; derived and ambient compute_sudo cases retain callback/write elevation.
side_effects: Bounded native ContextVar activation/reset and existing in-memory field cache updates. No SQL, schema, migrations, new ContextVar/store/coordinator or persistent role changes.

installed_mechanism: Existing Environment scopes are canonicalized in the current transaction by attached(); field-specific bindings are installed at the existing module binding phase; no Provider execution mechanism duplicated.
existing_adaptation: Consumer helpers read ambient channels rather than native record.env everywhere, so activate the attached environment at descriptor boundaries. Reuse native recordset.sudo for compute_sudo; do not invent a recordset for Django rows.
